title: isinstance(file, UploadFile) returns False

### Commit to Help

- [X] I commit to help with one of those options 👆

### Example Code

```python
@app.post("/users/{id}/files", status_code=204)
def upload_file(file: UploadFile):
    print(isinstance(file, UploadFile))
```
```


### Description

if you run the code example, you will obtain `False`. Is this intended behaviour?

The workaround is to use starlette: `isinstance(file, StarletteUploadFile)`

Linux
